newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-CAPRIATI'S COMEBACK TRAIL HITS DEAD END AT OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-CAPRIATI'S COMEBACK TRAIL HITS DEAD END AT OPEN.

text.p: Former tennis prodigy Jennifer Capriati saw her Australian Open comeback hit a dead end when fellow American Jolene Watanabe beat her 6-2 3-6 6-4 in the first round on Tuesday.
Capriati, 20, a quarter-finalist in Melbourne at the age of 15 in 1992 and again the following year, has made a second comeback in her career after falling prey to teenage burn-out in 1993.

After reaching the final of the Sydney International tour event last week, only to lose to Switzerland's Martina Hingis, few expected Capriati to have much trouble against the Californian, ranked 78 in the world.
But Watanabe, a 28-year-old who has never got beyond the second round in Melbourne, seemed unfazed by her opponent's reputation, waiting at the baseline for Capriati to make mistakes.
Capriati missed the previous three Australian Opens.
